chunks: “There is no harm in cutting gray hair or plucking it, and cutting it is more beloved to me than plucking it.”
So their reports عليهم السلام do not differ in one and the same circumstance, because their source is from Allah, exalted is His mention; rather, they differ according to the differing circumstances.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to cut or pluck gray hair in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that both cutting and plucking gray hair are permissible, though cutting is preferred over plucking. The concluding statement explains that differences in the reports from the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام arise from differing circumstances, not contradiction in a single situation.
